authority.name: Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes
authority.provider: California Academy of Sciences, Institute for Biodiversity Science and Sustainability
authority.accessMethod: Selected public catalog records were reviewed through indexed record pages; no raw catalog pages were downloaded or retained.
authority.reviewScope: Current nomenclature and family placement only. This does not re-identify specimens or validate a Bataan occurrence.

interpretation: These selected checks identify nomenclatural corrections and unresolved issues. Source names/families remain verbatim in the paper transcription. All 42 source-printed binomial rows remain pending overall review, all 10 genus-only/hybrid rows remain held, and none is admitted to the app.

records.finding: The species name is valid in the catalog; the printed family spelling differs from Anguillidae.
records.disposition: Keep the source spelling in transcription; treat family as a correction proposal only.

records.finding: An indexed related-name record treats Apogon tickelli as a synonym of Yarica hyalosoma, but the direct catalog record for the source name was not captured in this review.
records.disposition: Do not adopt the GBIF/CoL synonym proposal until the direct current catalog record and name history are checked.

records.finding: The catalog's current status uses Atropus hedlandensis; Carangoides hedlandensis is retained as a previous combination.
records.disposition: Keep the source spelling; proposed current-name mapping remains pending independent specimen/source-identity review.

records.finding: The catalog notes the species is known definitely only from Java river drainages according to Ng and Kottelat (2008), with records elsewhere treated as introduced.
records.disposition: The Bataan paper's report requires identity review; the catalog note is not evidence that the local report is absent or incorrect.

records.finding: Catalog records distinguish multiple bilineatus usages and discuss conflicting synonymy/combination treatments. The paper table gives no authorship or voucher detail to resolve which usage it intended.
records.disposition: Hold the source identification and all accepted-name mapping until the paper's reference/authorship or specimen documentation resolves the usage.

records.finding: The catalog's valid name is spelled Hypophthalmichthys nobilis; the paper table prints Hypopthalmichthys.
records.disposition: Preserve the source string and keep a proposed corrected name separate pending review of the paper's intended usage.

records.finding: The catalog recognizes the name in Platycephalidae, not the paper's printed Gobiidae family.
records.disposition: Keep the source family unchanged in the transcription; flag the family as a source conflict.

records.finding: The catalog's current status is Leiognathus equula; the source spelling equulus is listed among historical usage forms.
records.disposition: Retain the source string and keep the current-name mapping as a proposal pending record-level identity review.

records.finding: The catalog recognizes the species in Poeciliidae; the paper prints Poecilidae.
records.disposition: Keep source spelling; treat family spelling as a correction proposal only.

nextStep: Review the remaining 30 exact-species match rows against current fish-catalog records, then prepare river-scoped historical research proposals only for source-supported names whose usage can be resolved. Keep source identifications unverified where no voucher or independent specimen documentation is available.
